prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 43 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1355; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment kept growing well beyond what this injury usually needs, with more visits and new services added month after month.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision during a lane change, reporting neck and low back pain with associated stiffness and headaches. The mechanism of injury is consistent in type and force with the symptoms described. Initial examination showed reduced cervical and lumbar range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, supporting a soft tissue strain of the neck and back. Other neurological and orthopedic screening tests were within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar spine is documented in the available history. Care has included 43 visits to date, consisting of chiropractic manipulation, physical therapy, and soft tissue treatment. Over time, the frequency of visits and the number of added service types have increased steadily beyond what is typically expected for a strain of this severity, and the reasons for this escalation are not fully explained in the record. Billing review found no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. Recommendation is to reassess functional progress and establish a defined discharge plan with clear goals.
